instruction: Play the music video on the desktop in VLC, then pause the playback.

files.path: /home/user/Desktop/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

rules.file_name: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up (Official Music Video).mp4

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened VLC Media > Open File dialog, navigated to Desktop, selected the Rick Astley mp4, and played it. Task completed in 7 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with VLC menus, navigate file open dialog, browse directories, select and open media files, control playback
metadata.task_rationale: Adds a pause step after playing, requiring the agent to demonstrate playback control beyond just opening a file
metadata.explanation: Task requires opening the desktop video in VLC and then pausing it. Custom metric checks both correct file loaded (0.5) and paused state (0.5) for partial credit.

scoring_breakdown.correct_file: 0.5 - Correct video file loaded in VLC

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'vlc_playing_info' correctly fetches VLC status.xml via HTTP interface, which contains both playback state and currently loaded file metadata.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter: since expected.type='rule', the metric receives {'file_name': '...'} directly and uses expected.get('file_name', '') — correct pattern.

Metric checks both instruction requirements with appropriate partial credit: (0.5) correct file loaded by checking filename/title/uri in meta info, (0.5) paused state by checking <state> element equals 'paused'.
XML parsing paths (information/category[@name='meta']/info[@name='filename'] etc.) match VLC's actual status.xml structure.
Expected filename matches the downloaded file exactly, ensuring correct verification.
Full instruction coverage: 'play the music video' verified by file loaded check, 'pause the playback' verified by state check.
